release_notes: Build 61 restores the Website connection for installed users by recovering the existing Factburst Link Tracker configuration from legacy or development storage when available.
The tracker API key is never copied as a raw protected blob: it is read through the existing same-user credential protector and saved again into the installed app's persistent data folder.
A successful one-time recovery is recorded so a tracker configuration deliberately cleared later is not silently resurrected.
Existing installed Link Tracker settings are preserved and are never overwritten by legacy recovery.
Website settings now opens Settings directly on the Link Tracker page, where the existing Save and test action can be used if no recoverable configuration is available.
Build 60's aligned Needs You queue is unchanged: the current home count and queue count continue to use the same pending-task planner.
